_comment: P59: which stacks, setup steps, live settings and restarts each repository file reaches when it changes (tools/promotion_plan.py, tools/drift_check.py). Every tracked file must match at least one rule (tested); all matching rules apply. Globs as in modules.json: ** any path, * within one folder. 'stacks' are the stacks in deployment/stacks plus 'proxy' (route files on the production proxy), 'host' (tools installed on a server), 'test' (the test site only) and 'mobile'. Markdown files reach no stack. 'not_covered' names what the test site cannot validate: record a browser and protocol check right after promotion (AGENTS.md).

rules.name: ERP add-on
steps: build the ERP add-on image for this commit
deploy that one image to every ERP service
bench migrate (runs the add-on's after_migrate setup)
check the assets (tools/verify_erp_assets.py)

rules.name: ERP core and pinned apps
steps: build the ERP core image (tools/prepare_erp_image.py, tools/build_erp_core.py), then the add-on image on it
deploy that one image to every ERP service
bench migrate
check the assets (tools/verify_erp_assets.py)

rules.name: ERP runtime files
steps: render the ERP stack (tools/prepare_runtime.py) and redeploy it

rules.name: Company website
steps: render the website stack and redeploy it

rules.name: Drive
steps: render the Drive stack (web assets and configuration) and redeploy it

rules.name: Office editor
steps: render the editor stack and redeploy it
people reload the editor page (the browser may keep the old start page)
restart: editor (it saves open documents first; up to five minutes)

rules.name: Mail
steps: build the Mail image (tools/prepare_mail.py) when the overlay or pin changed
render the Mail stack and redeploy it
restart: webmail and, for stack changes, the mail server

rules.name: DMS
steps: render the DMS stack and redeploy it

rules.name: Chat (Matrix)
steps: render the chat stack and redeploy it (the configure service rewrites both configuration files; the signing key is kept)

rules.name: Document worker
steps: render the processing stack and redeploy it

rules.name: Private DNS
steps: render the private DNS stack and redeploy it

rules.name: Sign-in server
steps: render the identity stack and redeploy it
rules.not_covered: Test Authentik covers the isolated issuer; production provider mappings, mail transport and production recovery require separate validation.

rules.name: Sign-in companions (gateway, invitation pages)
steps: render the identity-support stack and redeploy it
run the invitation install scripts in integrations/authentik/invite-recovery when they changed
live: authentik invitation and recovery flows, brand and admin navigation (install scripts)
rules.not_covered: Test Authentik covers the isolated issuer; production provider mappings, mail transport and production recovery require separate validation.

rules.name: Sign-in configuration
live: authentik providers, flows, scope mappings and brand: apply the change in authentik (blueprint or by hand)
rules.not_covered: Test Authentik covers the isolated issuer; production provider mappings, mail transport and production recovery require separate validation.

rules.name: Mail archive reader sign-in (operator tool, P69)
live: run archive-reader/archive_reader_access.py in ak shell (plan, apply with a receipt, check) on the instance whose mail applications should admit the reader

rules.name: First administrator (operator tool, P77)
live: only when (re)setting the first administrator: run first-admin.sh against the authentik server container; it creates or refreshes the administrator without a password, prints a one-time passkey link and switches off akadmin
rules.not_covered: Test Authentik covers the tool; production has not run it. Check production's akadmin and that its sign-in flow admits the administrator's passkey before running it there.

rules.name: Production proxy routes
steps: install the changed route or proxy files on the production proxy (keep a copy of the old ones)
when deployment/coolify-proxy.json changed: run tools/coolify_proxy_image.py --restart on the host, then --check

when tools/coolify_proxy_tls_resolver.py is new or changed (or the running proxy lacks the resolver: --check): run it with --restart on the host at a quiet moment (about 16 seconds without the proxy), then --check
rules.not_covered: production-only route and proxy files: browser and protocol check right after promotion

rules.name: Rendering of every stack
steps: render every stack and compare the result with what runs; redeploy the stacks whose rendered files changed

rules.name: Host checks and watches
steps: update the installed copy on each server that runs it (host checks, editor safety, upstream watch, drift check, backup, snapshot export)

rules.name: Test site and refresh
steps: deploy to the test site (its deploy step re-renders it)

rules.name: Mobile app
steps: build and distribute the app (no server stack)

rules.name: No running stack (documents, tests, checks, operator tools)
